plugins.name: smdd-toolkit
plugins.description: Structured Markdown Driven Development skills for Claude Code. Plan projects as prose markdown before writing a line of code, then build component-by-component with atomic, parallel-safe sub-agents.

skills.name: smdd-check
skills.description: Folder-level coherence audit for an SMDD project. Reads every md in docs/<folder> and every corresponding source file under src/, cross-checks naming, field alignment, pair-contract compliance, and CLAUDE.md rule violations. Returns PASS/FAIL/WARN with a structured issue list. Use after an smdd-compile batch completes, as a pre-PR lint, or whenever coherence drift is suspected. Never auto-fixes — it only reports; fixes go back through smdd-code.
headings: When NOT to use this skill
skills.description_zh: 只读审查 SMDD 文件夹一致性，核对 docs 中每个 Markdown 与 src 对应文件的命名、字段、配对契约及 CLAUDE.md 规则，返回 PASS/FAIL/WARN 和问题清单。适用于批次构建后或 PR 前，不自动修复，修复回到 smdd-code。

skills.name: smdd-code
skills.description: Atomic WORK task for building one SMDD component. Use when asked to "implement this file", "build this component", "code the <X> md", or similar single-component asks inside an SMDD project (one with docs/{ui,backend,config}). Read the component's md, its pair md if one exists, and already-built dependencies; write the code file; write a test; run the test until green; commit on a feature branch; return a diff summary. Never edits files outside the declared target set — that's how sibling agents stay parallel-safe.
headings: When NOT to use this skill
skills.description_zh: 按原子任务实现单个 SMDD 组件，读取该组件及配对 Markdown 和已建依赖，写代码与测试、运行至通过，在功能分支提交并返回差异摘要。仅修改已声明目标文件，保持并行任务隔离。

skills.name: smdd-compile
skills.description: Orchestrator that builds a batch of SMDD components with parallel sub-agents. Use when asked to "build batch N", "implement all schemas in parallel", "compile this folder", or kick off a multi-component build. Determines which targets in the batch can run in parallel (disjoint file sets, satisfied dependencies), spawns one Agent per target with the right model (haiku for mechanical, sonnet for coupled), collects diffs, runs smdd-check over the touched folders, commits. Respects CLAUDE.md. Never parallelizes targets that share a file.
headings: When NOT to use this skill
skills.description_zh: 统筹多组件 SMDD 批次，按文件集合互斥及依赖满足情况分配并行子智能体，原说明机械任务用 haiku、耦合任务用 sonnet；收集差异、运行 smdd-check 并提交，遵循 CLAUDE.md，不并行修改共享文件。

skills.name: smdd
skills.description: Use this skill when the user mentions SMDD (Structured Markdown Driven Development), asks to "plan in SMDD style," asks to "create an SMDD outline," is working inside a directory that has the layout `docs/{ui,backend,config}` + `about.md` at its root, or asks to scaffold a new project as markdown-first docs before writing code. Enforces the three-step collaboration flow (plan then outline then per-component deep-dive then build) and the SMDD file and folder conventions.
skills.description_zh: 用于 Structured Markdown Driven Development，按 docs/ui、backend、config 与根 about.md 组织先文档后代码的项目，执行规划、提纲、逐组件深入及构建流程并遵守目录文件约定。
